verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript auth framework driven entirely in code. Its docs cover a server-side `auth.api` method surface, typed client methods such as `authClient.signUp.email`, plugin-exposed HTTP endpoints (JWT/JWKS, admin operations, API-key management), and a 'no dashboard clicks' code-first model, which community users describe as well documented. Gaps: no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec turned up, one user found programmatic admin scripts and tests 'very hacky' because of the request-header design, and the client library is JS-only with little guidance on writing other clients. Missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), smoother header-free scripting of the server API, documented non-JS client/HTTP contract.
